required_variables.description: The title or display name of the project
High-level purpose and core objective of this project
Name or role of the human stakeholder authorized to confirm decisions

web-fullstack.name: Fullstack Web Application
web-fullstack.description: Production-grade harness for database-driven web applications, microservices, and APIs.

variables.description: Core programming language
Backend and frontend frameworks
Database or storage engine
Authentication strategy (Recommended default: NextAuth.js/Auth.js; Alternatives: Supabase Auth, Clerk, or Custom Manual Session)
Hosting provider or cloud runtime

readiness_checks: Data persistence and schema defined
API contract and authentication boundaries established
Deployment targets and environment configurations verified

landing-page.name: Landing Page / Static Web
landing-page.description: Lean harness for high-converting marketing landing pages and responsive static sites.

variables.description: Intended visitor or customer persona
Main call-to-action button or conversion goal
Static web host (e.g. Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify)

readiness_checks: Headline, value proposition, and CTA copy approved
Section wireframe hierarchy and mobile responsiveness defined
Publishing host and analytics tracking confirmed

sales-outreach.name: Sales & B2B Outreach
sales-outreach.description: Operational harness for targeted sales outreach campaigns, lead pipelines, and deal closing.

variables.description: Target quota or revenue milestone
Ideal customer profile criteria
Primary contact channels (e.g. Email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp)

readiness_checks: Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and lead source lists prepared
Pitch messaging templates and objection scripts reviewed
Discount approval boundaries and follow-up cadence established

general-office.name: General Operations & Office Workflow
general-office.description: Structured harness for corporate operations, recurring reporting, research, and procedural tasks.

variables.description: Scope of work and departmental boundaries
Main deliverable format (e.g. Weekly Report, Audit Sheet)
Frequency of progress updates

readiness_checks: Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and approval matrix defined
Resource access and data inputs verified
Deliverable formats and review milestones confirmed

mobile-app.name: Mobile Application
mobile-app.description: Production harness for native and cross-platform mobile apps, store compliance, permissions, and build signing.

variables.description: Mobile framework or language (e.g. Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin)
Target mobile operating systems (iOS, Android, or Both)
Minimum supported mobile OS versions
Application package name or bundle identifier

readiness_checks: Target mobile operating systems and minimum OS versions defined
Hardware permissions and privacy manifests documented
App Store and Google Play compliance and signing keys configured

cli-automation.name: CLI Tool & Automation Script
cli-automation.description: Lightweight harness for command-line tools, background daemons, cron batch jobs, and data automation scripts.

variables.description: Scripting or systems programming language (e.g. Bash, Python, Go, Node.js)
Primary CLI binary or command alias
Execution model (e.g. Interactive CLI, Scheduled Cron, Daemon Worker)
Log destination (e.g. stdout, syslog, file rotation)

readiness_checks: CLI command syntax, flags, and exit codes defined
Process signal handling and daemon lifecycle established
Batch retry logic and failure quarantine procedures documented

content-marketing.name: Content Marketing & Social Media
content-marketing.description: Operational harness for editorial content planning, SEO keyword clusters, brand copywriting, and multi-channel publishing.

variables.description: Core themes or topical pillars for content production
Primary SEO keywords and search intent clusters
Brand tone of voice and editorial persona
Publishing channels (e.g. Blog, Newsletter, LinkedIn, YouTube, X)

readiness_checks: Editorial calendar cadence and content pillars established
SEO keyword clusters and search intent mapped
Brand tone of voice guidelines and review checklist approved

research-analysis.name: Research & Market Analysis
research-analysis.description: Analytical harness for industry research, competitor benchmarking, feasibility studies, and executive decision memos.

variables.description: Core research question or problem statement
Primary research approach (e.g. Qualitative, Quantitative, Literature Review, Competitive Matrix)
Data sources and verification hierarchy
Primary stakeholder audience for findings and recommendations

readiness_checks: Research questions, hypothesis, and scope boundaries confirmed
Primary data sources and citation standards defined
Executive decision memo format and risk trade-off criteria established

web-starter.name: Web Application Starter
web-starter.description: Lightweight, beginner-friendly starter harness for MVP web applications, quick prototypes, and static previews.

variables.description: Core programming language
Web framework or frontend library
Database or lightweight storage solution

readiness_checks: Core user flow and MVP page requirements defined
Framework, component architecture, and styling approach confirmed
Data persistence and basic testing criteria established

it-infra-ops.name: IT Infrastructure Operations & Maintenance
it-infra-ops.description: SOP-driven harness for on-premises server maintenance, node inventory, incident runbooks, backup/restore drills, and downtime mitigation.

variables.description: Infrastructure environment (e.g. On-Premises Data Center, Private Cloud, Virtualization Cluster)
Primary operating system (e.g. Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS, Debian 12, RHEL, Windows Server)
Scheduled recurring maintenance window
Backup destination storage (e.g. Local NAS, NFS Mount, Offsite Storage)

readiness_checks: Physical/VM server inventory and IP allocation mapped
Routine maintenance SOP and critical incident runbooks approved
Backup cadence and rollback mitigation procedures verified

app-maintenance.name: Application Maintenance & Brownfield Engineering
app-maintenance.description: Existing-system engineering harness for surgical bug patching, isolated custom module extensions, anti-regression, and upstream compatibility.

variables.description: Host/upstream application name and version (e.g. Odoo 17, WordPress, Legacy Custom ERP, Laravel Monolith)
Code source model (e.g. Open Source Upstream, Closed Source Vendor, Internal Proprietary)
Core programming language of the module/application
Extension or integration pattern (e.g. Modular Plugin, Event Hook/Listener, Core Patch, Middleware API)

readiness_checks: System context map and no-touch core boundaries defined
Bug reproduction SOP, impact assessment, and non-regression checklist established
Custom module isolation and upstream compatibility strategy confirmed
